{
  "page_id": "page-01",
  "page_type": "dashboard",
  "page_name": "Claim Simulator Dashboard",
  "purpose": "An interactive insurance claim simulation dashboard that allows users to select policy types and scenarios to predict approval rates, coverage gaps, and out-of-pocket expenses using AI-powered underwriting.",
  "navigation_to": ["Product", "Solutions", "Pricing", "Resources", "Login", "Get Started"],
  "color_palette": {
    "background": "#F5F7FA",
    "surface": "#FFFFFF",
    "text_primary": "#1A202C",
    "text_secondary": "#718096",
    "accent": "#1E40AF",
    "border": "#E2E8F0"
  },
  "typography": {
    "heading_font": "Inter, sans-serif",
    "body_font": "Inter, sans-serif",
    "heading_size_px": 24,
    "body_size_px": 14,
    "heading_weight": 600,
    "body_weight": 400
  },
  "layout": {
    "max_width_px": 1200,
    "container": "centered",
    "columns": 3,
    "header_present": true,
    "footer_present": true,
    "sidebar_present": false,
    "sections": [
      "Header Navigation",
      "Page Title & Description",
      "Main Simulation Grid (Left Controls, Center Results, Right Details)",
      "Coverage Chart Section",
      "AI Optimization Banner",
      "Footer"
    ]
  },
  "header": {
    "present": true,
    "logo_text": "InsurIntel AI",
    "nav_items": ["Product", "Solutions", "Pricing", "Resources"],
    "right_side": ["Login", "Get Started (Button)"],
    "background_color": "#FFFFFF",
    "sticky": true
  },
  "hero": {
    "present": false,
    "headline": "",
    "subheadline": "",
    "primary_cta": null,
    "secondary_cta": null
  },
  "content_sections": [
    {
      "name": "Simulation Interface",
      "type": "content_blocks",
      "heading": "Intelligent Underwriting",
      "subheading": "What-if Claim Simulator - Experience the power of precision underwriting. Simulate complex claim scenarios against your current policies to predict approval rates and coverage gaps instantly.",
      "items": [],
      "layout": "grid-3"
    },
    {
      "name": "Results Visualization",
      "type": "media_gallery",
      "heading": "Coverage vs. Out-of-Pocket Expenses",
      "subheading": "",
      "items": ["Bar chart comparing covered amount vs out-of-pocket for Hospital Charges, Room Rent, Surgeon Fee, Medicine, Lab Tests"],
      "layout": "rows"
    },
    {
      "name": "AI Recommendation",
      "type": "cta_band",
      "heading": "AI Strategy Optimization",
      "subheading": "Based on your 'Health Shield Pro Plus' policy and current scenario, our AI suggests shifting your hospital choice to St. Jude Preferred. By doing so, you will eliminate the 10% non-network penalty, increasing your net payout by $2,500.",
      "items": ["Apply Optimization Button", "Download Detailed Report Button"],
      "layout": "rows"
    }
  ],
  "footer": {
    "present": true,
    "columns": ["InsurIntel AI", "Product", "Company", "Legal"],
    "links": [
      "Precision Underwriting for the Modern Era.",
      "Solutions",
      "Pricing",
      "Resources",
      "About",
      "Careers",
      "Press",
      "Privacy",
      "Terms",
      "Security"
    ],
    "copyright_text": "© 2024 InsurIntel AI. Precision Underwriting for the Modern Era.",
    "social_icons": ["globe", "settings"],
    "background_color": "#FFFFFF"
  },
  "forms": [
    {
      "name": "Simulation Parameters",
      "fields": [
        { "label": "Choose Policy", "type": "select", "placeholder": "Health Shield Pro Plus", "required": true },
        { "label": "Choose Scenario", "type": "radio", "placeholder": "", "required": true },
        { "label": "Estimated Bill Amount", "type": "text", "placeholder": "$ 25,000", "required": true },
        { "label": "Hospital Type", "type": "select", "placeholder": "Tier 1 (Multi-specialty)", "required": true },
        { "label": "Room Type", "type": "select", "placeholder": "Private Suite", "required": true }
      ],
      "submit_button_label": "Run AI Simulation"
    }
  ],
  "buttons": [
    { "label": "Get Started", "style": "primary", "location": "Header" },
    { "label": "Run AI Simulation", "style": "primary", "location": "Sidebar Form" },
    { "label": "Apply Optimization", "style": "primary", "location": "AI Banner" },
    { "label": "Download Detailed Report", "style": "outline", "location": "AI Banner" },
    { "label": "Hospitalization", "style": "primary", "location": "Scenario Selector" },
    { "label": "Accident", "style": "ghost", "location": "Scenario Selector" },
    { "label": "Critical Illness", "style": "ghost", "location": "Scenario Selector" },
    { "label": "Surgery", "style": "ghost", "location": "Scenario Selector" },
    { "label": "Natural Disaster", "style": "ghost", "location": "Scenario Selector" }
  ],
  "icons": [
    "sparkles-icon (next to Intelligent Underwriting)",
    "check-circle-icon (Required Documents)",
    "warning-triangle-icon (Cautionary Risks)",
    "document-text-icon (Required Documents header)",
    "chart-pie-icon (Approval Probability circle)",
    "cpu-chip-icon (Run AI Simulation button)",
    "lightbulb-icon (AI Strategy Optimization header)"
  ],
  "images": [
    "Circular progress indicator showing 94% Approval Probability",
    "Bar chart showing financial breakdown of claim"
  ],
  "animations_interactions": [
    "Hover effects on scenario selection pills",
    "Interactive bar chart with tooltips",
    "Loading state for 'Run AI Simulation' button",
    "Smooth transitions for form field focus states"
  ],
  "responsive_cues": [
    "Grid layout collapses to single column on mobile",
    "Sidebar controls move above or below results on smaller screens",
    "Chart becomes horizontally scrollable on very small viewports"
  ],
  "notes": "The page uses a clean, clinical aesthetic typical of fintech/insurtech dashboards. The primary blue (#1E40AF) is used for active states and primary CTAs. The layout is a 3-column grid where the left column contains inputs, the center column shows the main result card, and the right column shows supporting details like risks and documents."
}
